notes:
New Features:

- Settings and Release Notes now use a large Cumination-style dark layout with rounded corners, a subtle neon-red outer glow and red active/button accents.
- The Settings entry in the Site and the Settings window title are now bold white so they remain clearly separated from the colored Site entries and red navigation controls.

Improvements:

- Redlight HD now uses the proven direct .com child-playlist path by default; the experimental localhost relay remains available in the code but is no longer inserted automatically.
- The final Redlight playback route is shown only after the actual stream path has been selected, including direct-child playback and EOF recovery.
- The post-update Release Notes window now uses the same large proportions and visual style as Settings.
- Release Notes section titles are now bold while retaining their green, orange and red section colors.
- Settings Release Notes use safer full-width wrapping to prevent words from being truncated at the right edge.

Bugfixes:

- Avoids Redlight entering the unstable relay path that failed local preflight with HTTP 502 before falling back to direct playback in v1.119.
- Keeps mouse-wheel, keyboard and Yatse Release Notes scrolling on the same document-wide viewport while preserving the wider text layout.
